read.thesis: Record 7.0Mt shipments and steel mills backlog up 20% to 4.7Mt; imports cut to ~15% share from 22%, with pricing discipline and 2026 volume guide raised toward ~10%.

utilisation.quote: Nucor's operating rate is about 87% right now, utilization across the board

capex.quote: we remain on track with our $2.5 billion CapEx estimate for the full year

triggers.label: Import share 22% → ~15%
triggers.quote: Import share of the U.S. finished steel market declined from over 22% in the first quarter of 2025 to approximately 15% this quarter.

triggers.label: Steel mills backlog 4.7Mt, +20% QoQ
triggers.quote: our steel mills backlog was up to 4.7 million tons, a 20% increase from year-end

triggers.label: Capex moderating; FCF improving
triggers.quote: it is moderating compared to recent years. And as our CapEx is trending down, our cash from operations is moving up.

triggers.label: 2026 shipments growth >5%, possibly ~10%
triggers.quote: I think it's much more likely that it pushes closer to double digits.

triggers.label: Sheet pricing lagging market catch-up
triggers.quote: where the pricing is catching up with catching up with the trends that you're seeing today in the marketplace

guidance.quote: we expect shipments to grow by more than 5% in 2026
we remain on track with our $2.5 billion CapEx estimate for the full year

guidance.value: at least 40% of net earnings annually
guidance.quote: we remain committed to returning at least 40% of net earnings to shareholders on an annual basis
we'll be operating somewhere near that 50% of capacity by the end of next year

guidance.value: higher consolidated earnings across all 3 segments
guidance.quote: we expect higher consolidated earnings with improvement across all 3 operating segments

red_flags.label: Pre-operating costs rising ahead of WV ramp
red_flags.quote: we expect these costs to trend higher as we work our way further into 2026

evasions.quote: Not taking that entirely off the table. It's just our traditional practice has been through buybacks

evasions.topic: Imports EO and new US steel capacity
evasions.quote: we're still a wait-and-see approach on that EO
